title: A Will for the Confession
author: Lena Quintana
blurb: Quentin Almeida, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
